|---|---|

| Europe | 4,377 |
| Asia | 83 |
| Total | 11,047 |

In addition, american living and chaps-branded products distributed by our wholesale segment were sold domestically through approximately 1800 doors as of march 31, 2012. As of march 31, 2012, we had approximately 18000 shop-within-shops dedicated to our ralph lauren-branded wholesale products worldwide. The size of our shop-within-shops ranges from approximately 300 to 7400 square feet. We normally share in the cost of building-out these shop-within-shops with our wholesale customers. Basic stock replenishment program.
